summary.text: Ed Murray is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 97, representing Orleans, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2026 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Ed Murray's occupation as Attorney.
It lists Ed Murray's education as Bachelor of Science Juris Doctor.
The House member page lists Ed Murray's committee assignments as Insurance; Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs; Transportation, Highways and Public Works.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus; Orleans Delegation.
